title: Your Claude Agent Layer: CRM, Database and Slack From One Webhook

sections.label: 1 - CLAUDE AGENT WORKFLOW
sections.note: Your parts 1 and 2. A customer message hits the webhook and a Claude agent decides which of its four tools to call.

sections.label: 2 - CRM, DATABASE AND SLACK, READ AND UPDATED
sections.note: Your parts 3 to 6. HubSpot, your orders database and Slack hang under the agent as its tools; this step sends the answer back to whatever called the webhook.

sections.label: 3 - ERROR HANDLING, MONITORING AND TESTING
sections.note: Your parts 7 to 9. Every run is logged with the tools the agent called, and any failed step posts to Slack with a link to retry it.

nodes.label: 1 - New Customer Message Arrives by Webhook
2 - Claude Agent Reads It and Picks Its Tools
nodes.notes: An agent, not a fixed script: a tracking question and a refund ask take different tools.

params.system_message:
You are the customer operations agent for an online store that sells on Shopify. Customer messages come to you from the help desk or the site's contact form. Your job: understand what the customer needs, check the facts with your tools, keep HubSpot current, hand anything you must not decide to the team in Slack, and write the reply.

Always in this order: 1) HubSpot - Find the Customer, by the sender's email. 2) Orders Database - Look Up Their Shopify Orders, by the same email. Answer order questions only from what the database returns: status, carrier, tracking number, shipped and delivered dates. Never guess a date or promise a delivery day the carrier has not shown. 3) HubSpot - Update the Contact with the topic and whether an issue is still open. 4) Slack - Hand It to the Team only when a person must decide: any refund or replacement above the refund limit you are given, a chargeback or legal threat, a wholesale, press or influencer request, an angry customer, or a message you cannot match to any order.

topic is one of: order_status, return_or_refund, replacement, product_question, change_order, wholesale_or_partnership, other. If the email matches no HubSpot contact, still look up orders; if both come back empty, ask the customer for their order number in the reply and set needs_person to false. If the message is empty or unreadable, set topic to other and needs_person to true.

The reply is 2 to 4 short sentences in a warm, plain voice, signed with the brand name you are given, with the tracking link when there is one. When a person must decide, the reply says the team is checking and will answer today; it never promises a refund.

nodes.label: HubSpot - Find the Customer
nodes.notes: Reads your CRM first, so the agent knows who it is talking to.

params.toolDescription: Find the customer in HubSpot by email. Call first, once per message. Returns the contact id, name, lifecycle stage, last support topic and whether an issue is open.

values.name: email
values.description: The sender's email exactly as it arrived

nodes.label: Orders Database - Look Up Their Shopify Orders
nodes.notes: The answer comes from your data, never from the model's guess.

params.toolDescription: Look up the customer's five most recent Shopify orders in the orders database, by email. Returns order number, status, total, carrier, tracking number, shipped and delivered dates.
Update the customer's HubSpot contact after you know the topic. Call once, only when Find the Customer returned a contact id.

values.name: contact_id
values.description: The HubSpot contact id from Find the Customer

values.name: topic
values.description: The topic you chose for this message

values.name: open_issue
values.description: true when the team still has to act, else false

values.name: order_number
values.description: The order the message is about, or an empty string

nodes.label: Slack - Hand It to the Team
nodes.notes: Refunds over your limit and anything touchy go to a person, with the facts attached.

params.toolDescription: Post a hand-off to the team's Slack channel when a person must decide. Call at most once per message, last.

values.name: handoff
values.description: Customer name and email, order number and status, what they want, why a person must decide, and the reply draft

nodes.label: Parser - Topic, Actions and Reply Draft

tools_called: Orders Database - Look Up Their Shopify Orders
schema.reply_draft: Hi Dana, order #1047 left us on Sept 17 with USPS and last scanned in Memphis on Monday. Here is the live tracking: https://tools.usps.com/go/TrackConfirmAction?tLabels=9400111899223197428490. If it has not moved by Friday, reply here and the team will sort out a replacement.

nodes.label: 3 - Send the Answer Back on the Webhook
nodes.notes: Your help desk gets the reply draft and what the agent did, in one response.
